tools.name: loyverse_get_merchant
tools.description: Fetch the merchant account this token belongs to — business name, email, country and currency. A cheap way to confirm the token works. Loyverse: GET /merchant/.

tools.name: loyverse_list_stores
tools.description: List the merchant's stores (locations) with their addresses. Store ids are what the receipt, shift and inventory filters take. Loyverse: GET /stores.

tools.name: loyverse_list_employees
tools.description: List employees, with the stores each can access and whether they are the owner. Loyverse: GET /employees.

tools.name: loyverse_list_receipts
tools.description: List sales and refund receipts, newest first, with line items, payments, discounts and taxes. Filter by store, time range or receipt numbers — the core of any sales question. Loyverse: GET /receipts.

tools.name: loyverse_get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a single receipt by its receipt number (e.g. 2-1008), with line items, modifiers, discounts, taxes and payments. Loyverse: GET /receipts/{receipt_number}.

tools.name: loyverse_list_shifts
tools.description: List cash-register shifts with their cash, gross/net sales, refunds, discounts, taxes, per-payment-type totals and pay-in/pay-out movements — the end-of-day view. Loyverse: GET /shifts.

tools.name: loyverse_list_items
tools.description: List catalog items with their variants (SKU, barcode, price, cost, per-store pricing), category, taxes and modifiers. Loyverse: GET /items.

tools.name: loyverse_get_item
tools.description: Fetch a single catalog item by id, with its variants. Loyverse: GET /items/{item_id}.

tools.name: loyverse_list_variants
tools.description: List item variants — the sellable SKUs — optionally for given items or one SKU. Variant ids are what inventory levels are keyed on. Loyverse: GET /variants.

tools.name: loyverse_list_categories
tools.description: List item categories. Loyverse: GET /categories.

tools.name: loyverse_list_inventory
tools.description: List current stock (`in_stock`) per variant per store. Filter by stores and/or variants — the answer to 'what is running low?'. Loyverse: GET /inventory.

tools.name: loyverse_list_customers
tools.description: List loyalty customers, newest first, with visits, total spent and points balance. Filter by email or ids. Loyverse: GET /customers.

tools.name: loyverse_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id, with visits, total spent and points balance. Loyverse: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: loyverse_list_payment_types
tools.description: List the payment types (cash, card, integrated terminals…) and the stores where each is available. Receipt payments reference these ids. Loyverse: GET /payment_types.

tools.name: loyverse_list_discounts
tools.description: List configured discounts (fixed/variable percent or amount, discount-by-points) and where they apply. Loyverse: GET /discounts.

tools.name: loyverse_list_taxes
tools.description: List taxes with their rate, whether they are INCLUDED in or ADDED to the price, and the stores they apply in. Loyverse: GET /taxes.

tools.name: loyverse_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their contact details. Loyverse: GET /suppliers/.

tools.name: loyverse_upsert_customer
tools.description: Create a loyalty customer, or update one by passing its `id`. Loyverse does not document whether omitted fields survive an update, so on update fetch the customer first and send the full record. Loyverse: POST /customers.

tools.name: loyverse_upsert_category
tools.description: Create an item category, or rename/recolor one by passing its `id`. Loyverse: POST /categories.

tools.name: loyverse_upsert_supplier
tools.description: Create a supplier, or update one by passing its `id`. Loyverse does not document whether omitted fields survive an update, so on update send the full record. Loyverse: POST /suppliers/.

tools.name: loyverse_set_inventory_levels
tools.description: Set the ABSOLUTE stock (`stock_after`) of one or more variants at given stores — e.g. after a stock count. This overwrites the current level rather than adding to it; read the current levels with loyverse_list_inventory first so they can be restored. Loyverse: POST /inventory.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: loyverse_get_merchant, loyverse_list_customers, loyverse_upsert_customer, loyverse_set_inventory_levels · Private data: loyverse_get_merchant, loyverse_list_suppliers, loyverse_upsert_customer, loyverse_upsert_supplier · Public sink: loyverse_get_merchant, loyverse_list_customers, loyverse_upsert_customer, loyverse_upsert_category, loyverse_upsert_supplier, loyverse_set_inventory_levels.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: loyverse_get_merchant, loyverse_list_customers, loyverse_upsert_customer, loyverse_set_inventory_levels · Private data: loyverse_get_merchant, loyverse_list_suppliers, loyverse_upsert_customer, loyverse_upsert_supplier · Public sink: loyverse_get_merchant, loyverse_list_customers, loyverse_upsert_customer, loyverse_upsert_category, loyverse_upsert_supplier, loyverse_set_inventory_levels

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
